note: FED §8 partition first deliverable: §6.6 exposure gate + §6.8 exposure-transition vectors (incl. r5 N1 widening-order). The exposure gate is a pure {verified, org_grant_exposure, static_expose, request} -> decision comparison (condition-table form, per CKCRED's ceiling_gate precedent). The transition vectors are state-machine scenarios; effective_before_durable is the in-memory latch state, effective_after_durable is post-durable-commit. Consumers vendor by commit hash. ExposeEntry shape: exactly-one-of {module, tool} | {module, operation}, deny-unknown-fields (crates/fed-core/src/profile.rs:133-137).

gate_vectors.name: org_grant_supersedes_static_tool_only_in_static_denied
gate_vectors.rationale: org-grant governs (provenance Local < OrgGrant); write is in static but not org-grant -> denied

gate_vectors.name: org_grant_supersedes_static_tool_only_in_org_grant_allowed
gate_vectors.rationale: org-grant governs; write is in org-grant -> allowed if verified

gate_vectors.name: verified_but_not_exposed_denied
gate_vectors.rationale: exposure axis fails -> denied even though verified

gate_vectors.name: exposed_but_not_verified_denied
gate_vectors.rationale: verified axis (roster) fails -> denied even though exposed; the conjunction requires both

gate_vectors.name: empty_org_grant_denies_all_not_static_fallback
gate_vectors.rationale: empty [] = org-grant explicitly exposes nothing -> deny all (empty != absent); static NOT consulted

gate_vectors.name: both_absent_denied
gate_vectors.rationale: no org-grant, no static -> nothing exposed (fail-closed)

gate_vectors.name: tool_entry_does_not_match_operation_request
gate_vectors.rationale: a Tool entry does not satisfy an Operation request (surface mismatch)

shape_vectors.name: both_tool_and_operation_rejected
shape_vectors.rationale: exactly-one-of; both present -> rejected at parse (fail-closed)

shape_vectors.name: duplicate_entry_rejected
shape_vectors.rationale: duplicate (module, tool) -> rejected (matches existing profile validation)

transition_vectors.name: withdrawal_to_broader_static_delays_until_durable_N1
transition_vectors.crash_between_latch_and_durable: effective set never wider than last durable state (read only); write (the widening) is NOT exposed before the durable commit
transition_vectors.rationale: r5 N1: static {read,write} is BROADER than org-grant {read}; the widening (write) delays until durable; never widen in-memory before durable (fail-open)

transition_vectors.name: withdrawal_to_narrower_static_latches_immediately
transition_vectors.crash_between_latch_and_durable: effective set already narrowed (write removed in-memory immediately); fail-closed shrink
transition_vectors.rationale: static {read} is NARROWER than org-grant {read,write}; the narrowing (write removed) latches in-memory immediately under 0.3 latch-before-durable

transition_vectors.name: withdrawal_partial_overlap_decomposes
transition_vectors.crash_between_latch_and_durable: read removed immediately (narrowing); delete (widening) NOT exposed before durable; write persists throughout
transition_vectors.rationale: partial overlap: read is org-grant-only (removed immediately, narrowing); delete is static-only (added only after durable, widening); write is in both (persists)

transition_vectors.name: interruption_never_widens
transition_vectors.crash_between_latch_and_durable: no change; last durable org-grant {read} governs; the broader static {read,write} is NOT applied on a transient fault
transition_vectors.rationale: F4: a failed/partial/stale reconcile changes NOTHING; never widen to static on a transient fault (fail-open). The forwarder holds the last durable org-grant set; no representable mid-reconcile provenance

transition_vectors.name: explicit_withdrawal_vs_interruption_distinction
transition_vectors.crash_between_latch_and_durable: narrowing to empty (deny all) latches immediately; fail-closed
transition_vectors.rationale: a COMPLETE reconcile carrying grant-absent -> None (static governs; here static is empty -> deny all). Contrast: a failed reconcile with the same inputs would leave org-grant {read} governing (no change)

transition_vectors.name: org_grant_arrives_supersedes_static
transition_vectors.rationale: a COMPLETE authoritative reconcile sets org_grant_exposure; it supersedes static (provenance Local < OrgGrant). The arrival is a capability change reconciled under 0.3 ordering
